source: Derived from client_documents/20260917 Senseigigs_NUS_Test_Dataset_Team31.xlsx by labeller/experiments/build_gold.py -- rerun it rather than editing this file.
annotator: The client, writing with an LLM. NOT measured ground truth and NOT human annotation: the workbook's 0-100 expected_score_range values are one model's opinion and are deliberately NOT carried over here. Only the ordinal four-band judgement is, mapped onto the 0-3 rubric below. Treat as a development target, not a measurement of matching quality.
caveats: 1:1 pairing only -- the workbook never claims anything about the other 29 providers per gig, but evaluate.py scores unlabelled providers as grade 0.

The 4 NEAR-MISS gigs have no provider graded >=1, so NDCG is undefined for them (evaluate.py reports nan). Check those with report_near_miss() instead: they are passed by scoring LOW, which a ranking metric cannot see.
The gigs and showcases are synthetic Singapore-SME scenarios; the extracted corpus is global big-4 consulting. Good scores here do not transfer automatically.

rubric.3: Shortlist: the showcase meets the gig's core need (client band OBVIOUS).
rubric.2: Relevant: a real connection that isn't obvious from keywords (client band SUBTLE).
rubric.1: Marginal: meaningful overlap, imperfect fit (client band PARTIAL).
rubric.0: Not relevant, including deliberate near-misses that look similar on the surface (client band NEAR-MISS), and every provider the workbook left unpaired.

rationales.client_showcase_03: Direct match. Same regulatory context (PSA, MAS, AML/CFT), same deliverable (gap review, policy recommendations).

client_gig_29.title: Review Vocational Training Curriculum for Ex-Offenders

client_gig_30.title: Help Us Write Our Annual Impact Report

rationales.client_showcase_30: Both involve charities and report production. But hirer needs writing from existing data (content task). Provider explicitly states they do NOT do programme evaluation or data analysis - only design and layout from client-provided content. However, if hirer has the data ready, this could actually be a reasonable fit - the near-miss is subtle and intentional.
